summary: FRONTEND-ONLY regression test of the structural refactor of /game/damma — END-TO-END PASS. The parent screen damma.tsx (now 692 lines, down from 1180) bundles cleanly and renders identically to the iteration_5 baseline. The 5 extracted components (WoodenTable, BoneyardPanel, HandTray, PlayerCard, DominoTile + shared theme.ts) all mount correctly. Verified: (1) BUNDLER — no compile/Metro errors, no red screen, page loads. (2) VISUAL — wooden walnut frame, green felt, gold 'ضمنة • Classic Game' title pill, green-glow active player card on Tester (testID damma-player-card-me, score 0), gold-tinted bot card '🤖 متوسط' (testID damma-player-card-bot), vertical wooden BONEYARD panel with gold label and badge showing 14, wooden hand tray with 7 cream domino tiles. (3) GAMEPLAY — tapping the first hand tile auto-plays it (hand: 7→6), 🤖 Thinking… indicator (testID damma-thinking) appears on bot's turn for ~5 s, then bot plays. (4) TIMER — testID damma-timer ticks 59s → 56s over 2.2 s as expected. (5) 4-PLAYER MODE — opening damma-mode-picker → damma-mode-4 correctly spawns damma-player-card-left, damma-player-card-top and damma-player-card-right around the felt. (6) DIFFICULTY — damma-difficulty-picker opens, damma-diff-easy selection updates the bot label to '🤖 سهل'. (7) RESET — damma-reset-btn clears the board, hand returns to 7 tiles, timer resets to ~60s. (8) LOBBY — damma-lobby-link navigates to /game/damma-lobby successfully. (9) TESTIDs — all 9 required testIDs are present exactly once each: damma-back-btn (1), damma-lobby-link (1), damma-mode-picker (1), damma-difficulty-picker (1), damma-reset-btn (1), damma-player-card-me (1), damma-player-card-bot (1), damma-timer (1), damma-boneyard (1). Hand tile testIDs follow the damma-hand-tile-{L}-{R} convention with 7 tiles initially. No regressions vs iteration_5 baseline.
critical_code_review_comments: damma.tsx parent screen is now 692 lines (down from 1180) — under the 700-line guideline. Refactor is clean: components/theme.ts centralises palette constants, each sub-component is pure presentation with prop-based variants (PlayerCard variant='me'|'bot'|'top'|'side'). Engine code untouched.

Pre-existing console warnings observed (NOT a regression — also present in iteration_5): 'shadow*' style props deprecated (use boxShadow), 'textShadow*' deprecated, 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated', and 'Unexpected text node:  . A text node cannot be a child of a <View>' fires from inside the Pressable modal cards in damma.tsx lines 515/542 (whitespace between '<Pressable ...>' and '<Text>' children). These do not affect rendering but should be cleaned up in a future iteration.
